biography:
John is a real estate development project manager in data infrastructure and utility-scale renewable energy. Skilled at managing varied stakeholders and solving complex and ambiguous problems, John always looks for the middle ground that benefits as many as possible. While no stranger to diving directly into tasks themselves, he also comfortably coordinates with multiple teams to accomplish development activities such as site strategy and selection, assessment and diligence, layout and design, and entitlements and incentives. John's favorite achievement to date has been managing the rezoning, preliminary plan, and abatements awarded to Rocky Branch Creek Technology Park in Kansas City, Missouri.

John leans into discomfort and dives into new tasks for personal growth. He leverages a broad engineering background with a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) in Chemical Engineering with an Environmental focus and a Master of Civil Engineering (M.C.E.) from the University of Kansas; his education and experience in urban planning give him additional insight into how best to implement solutions to meet clients' clean energy and data infrastructure goals, whether they are fiber or data center development. He began an MBA with the UMKC Bloch School of Business in 2023 and intends to finish in 2026.
